def transform(grid):
    anchors = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]

    def density(p):
        r, c = p
        return sum(
            grid[rr][cc] != 0
            for rr in range(max(0, r - 3), min(len(grid), r + 4))
            for cc in range(max(0, c - 3), min(len(grid[0]), c + 4))
            if (rr, cc) != p
        )

    src = max(anchors, key=density)
    dst = next(p for p in anchors if p != src)
    dr, dc = dst[0] - src[0], dst[1] - src[1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
